verification.tests: repository contract, lifecycle self-test, 24 hook tests, and 25 portfolio/automation tests

verified_contracts: Every declared check remains in the verification denominator.
Every undeclared required verification type remains an unmet denominator obligation.
Completed work rejects planned, blocked, or failed declared checks even when another check of the same type passed.
Lifecycle and traceability metric models are labeled and aggregated separately.
Evidence freshness uses the oldest contributing evidence timestamp, not dashboard generation or unrelated metadata time.
Release, publication, deployment, and production proof remain outside implementation metric scores.
